# For Every Path

> Independent publishing and stationery project by Sajbán-Frőhner Alexandra. Thoughtful conversation cards, planning tools and reflective workbooks. No separate company or active webshop is claimed.

Canonical website for now: https://880rzz.github.io/newvibe/
Planned future domain: https://foreverypath.com/ (not connected; do not treat as canonical yet)
Available site languages: EN (default), HU, DE, FR. Original physical publications are in Hungarian.
Localized brandlines: EN “Room for every journey.”; HU “Minden úton van helyed.”; DE “Raum für deinen Weg.”; FR “À chacun son chemin.”

## Official pages
- English homepage: https://880rzz.github.io/newvibe/
- Hungarian: https://880rzz.github.io/newvibe/hu/

The creator reported on 2026-11-21 that the content of all nine editions is final and professionally approved. This is an editorial statement, not proof of physical stock, institutional endorsements or commercial licensing.

## Nine product editions
- Helyed van köztünk: https://880rzz.github.io/newvibe/products/helyed-van-koztunk.html
  A 36-card illustrated discussion deck on bullying and exclusion with 16-part safety/help leaflet. Real product photos available.
- Egy kis tér: https://880rzz.github.io/newvibe/products/egy-kis-ter.html
  Hungarian adult (18+) reflection workbook, 24 situations, 3 filled examples and 6 worksheets. Professionally approved content per the publisher's 2026-11-21 update; AI-assisted editing/illustrations declared.
- Lépésről lépésre 2027: https://880rzz.github.io/newvibe/products/lepesrol-lepesre-2027.html
  Hungarian 2027 planner for adults with ADHD, flexible monthly/weekly planning, finances, errands, routines and gentle days. Print files provided; finished print not verified.
- Határidőnapló tanároknak 2027 illustrated: https://880rzz.github.io/newvibe/products/tanari-hataridonaplo-2027-szines.html
- Határidőnapló tanároknak 2027 minimal: https://880rzz.github.io/newvibe/products/tanari-hataridonaplo-2027-letisztult.html
  Two cover designs of the same teacher planner content, 2027 annual/monthly/weekly planning, notes and personal reflection. Print files provided; finished print not verified.

- Veled a mindennapokban: https://880rzz.github.io/newvibe/products/veled-a-mindennapokban.html
  30-day Catholic prayer and reflection journal in Hungarian, 84 A5 pages, manuscript dated 2026-11-18; Scriptures cited from Káldi-Neovulgáta (KNB) and Catechism (KEK). The manuscript discloses AI assistance. The publisher confirms professional content approval. No official ecclesiastical endorsement is claimed. The image is an AI concept, not a real printed book photograph.

- Mesék a világ körül: https://880rzz.github.io/newvibe/products/mesek-a-vilag-korul.html
  Diófa Műhely Hungarian A4 story collection, 131 pages, 42 countries and 42 folktales, legends and literary stories. Source revision 2026-11-19. The source previously noted copyright/translation questions; professional editorial approval was confirmed subsequently. This public repository is not evidence of commercial licences.
- Mesék a világ körül – 42 színező: https://880rzz.github.io/newvibe/products/mesek-a-vilag-korul-szinezo.html
  Companion Hungarian 42-page A4 set of line-art coloring pages keyed to the 42 stories. Professionally approved 42-page companion; cover illustration is a digital mock-up.
- Na, most mit csináljak?: https://880rzz.github.io/newvibe/products/na-most-mit-csinaljak.html
  Diófa Műhely A4 activity/story book, 139 pages, 32 stories for ages 8–11. Based on Sajbán-Frőhner Alexandra's editorial concept; source acknowledges AI-assisted text and illustration. Fictional Kóka-inspired settings do not imply institutional affiliation.

## Email pre-order requests
Pre-order requests for all nine product editions can be sent to diofamuhelykozosseg@gmail.com. This is an email inquiry channel; sending an email does not confirm a binding purchase, reserve inventory, or collect payment. Prices, delivery expectations and terms will be confirmed individually before an order can be finalised. The standalone webshop and domain remain in preparation. Fulfilment terms and applicable publication permissions are addressed separately from the professional approval of the publication content.

## Truthfulness and safeguards
No public product prices, checkout or live webshop links. Email pre-order requests are available, but there is no confirmed website order, stock reservation or automatic payment. No unverified commercial offers, company identifiers, reviews, endorsements or clinical claims.
The mock cover previews are illustrative and not photographs of manufactured books.
No therapy or diagnosis is provided. The card set is a discussion aid, not a substitute for safeguarding or emergency help.
Contact shown on physical cards: diofamuhelykozosseg@gmail.com.
